# HacknetHotReplace
Hacknet Hot Replace Extension File Support

[中文简体](README.md)



## Prerequisites

You need to install [Pathfinder](https://github.com/Arkhist/Hacknet-Pathfinder) before using this mod



## Usage

This plugin must be installed globally:

Extract the Release package and copy the dll file to: `Hacknet.exe file dir/BepInEx/plugins` directory.



## Hot Replace

All currently supported hot replace features are:

* Hot reload Computer
* Connect to a specified Computer and grant admin permissions
* Hot reload Mission files
* Hot reload Action files
* Hot reload Faction files
* Hot reload Theme files
* Hot reload People files (reload all People files at once)
* Dynamic Action Execution
* Print current game OS information
* Print specified computer information
* Locate the call stack of draw elements



After global installation, when you start the game, the hot replace plugin will listen on system ports as a server, and when the client sends commands, the plugin will execute the commands and return results to the client.

When the game starts, the hot replace plugin will write its listening port to the Windows registry so that the client can get the port to send commands. And as long as the plugin is running, it will write the current latest timestamp (in milliseconds) to the registry every 2 seconds, so that the client knows if the service is available.

1. Listening port 

   ​	windows: registry entry: `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Hacknet`, Key=`HotReplaceServerPort`

   ​	linux: 	~/.HacknetHotReplace/HotReplaceServerOnlineTimespan

2. Real-time writing timestamp

   ​	windows:  registry entry: `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Hacknet`, Key=`HotReplaceServerOnlineTimespan`

   ​	linux: 	~/.HacknetHotReplace/HotReplaceServerPort



### Client Messages

The client can use UDP protocol to send data to the plugin in the following format.

ip: `127.0.0.1`

port: `Read registry: ` `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Hacknet`, key=`HotReplaceServerPort`



Request Message Format

```xml
<Command>
      <CommandType>Message Type</CommandType>
      <MsgGuid>Message unique id (generated by client)</MsgGuid>
      <Payload>Custom message payload</Payload>
 </Command>
```

Response Message Format

```xml
<CommandResponse>
      <CommandType>Message Type</CommandType>
      <MsgGuid>Message unique id (generated by client)</MsgGuid>
      <Success>Whether the command executed successfully true/false</Success>
      <Payload>Response data</Payload>
 </CommandResponse>
```



#### Open and Enter Specified Extension Message

```xml
<!-- Request -->
<Command>
    <CommandType>EnterExtension</CommandType>
    <MsgGuid>71315d64-e676-4ff9-98eb-601a6f0c91f3</MsgGuid>
    <Payload>
        <ExtensionFolder>Extension directory absolute path</ExtensionFolder>
        <NeedApproval>Whether user confirmation is needed (true/false)</NeedApproval>
        <EnterNoAccount>Whether to directly enter no account mode (true/false)</EnterNoAccount>
    </Payload>
</Command>

<!-- Response -->
<CommandResponse>
  <CommandType>EnterExtension</CommandType>
  <MsgGuid>8044a465-6a8e-436a-ad27-481da62effd1</MsgGuid>
  <Success>True</Success>
  <Payload>success</Payload>
</CommandResponse>
```


#### Dynamic Action Execution

```xml
<!-- Request -->
<Command>
    <CommandType>ExecuteAction</CommandType>
    <MsgGuid>d59de976-3704-47cc-a0a2-fb628beb5efe</MsgGuid>
    <Payload>
        <!-- Store the Action to be dynamically executed inside ActionXmlContent -->
        <ActionXmlContent>
            <ShowModule2 Names="[ALL]"></ShowModule2>
        </ActionXmlContent>
    </Payload>
</Command>

<!-- Response -->
<CommandResponse>
  <CommandType>HotReloadPeople</CommandType>
  <MsgGuid>be524cea-a6a5-4654-8687-84ad654fbdd4</MsgGuid>
  <Success>True</Success>
  <Payload>success</Payload>
</CommandResponse>
```

#### Print Computer Information

```xml
<!-- Request -->
<Command>
    <CommandType>PrintComputer</CommandType>
    <MsgGuid>d181d2e9-7a65-48a7-aed5-847e262e6ef8</MsgGuid>
    <Payload>
        <!-- Computer ID -->
        <ComputerId>playerComp</ComputerId>
    </Payload>
</Command>

<!-- Response -->
<CommandResponse>
  <CommandType>PrintComputer</CommandType>
  <MsgGuid>d181d2e9-7a65-48a7-aed5-847e262e6ef8</MsgGuid>
  <Success>True</Success>
   <!-- Inside is the generated computer save -->
  <Payload>&lt;computer name="fengx Workstation" ip="81.243.206.126" type="4" spec="player" id="playerComp"&gt;
  &lt;location x="0.4724679" y="0.9782055" /&gt;
  &lt;security level="3" traceTime="300" adminIP="81.243.206.126" portsToCrack="100" /&gt;
  ...........
  </Payload>
</CommandResponse>
```



#### Print Game Draw Element Stack Information

After sending the message, click on the interface element in the game with the middle mouse button to locate the call stack of that element's drawing method.

```xml
<!-- Request -->
<Command>
    <CommandType>AnalysisDrawCall</CommandType>
    <MsgGuid>5489449c-c463-4ac3-a7ed-e166ac8de4c8</MsgGuid>
    <Payload>
        <!--
 			graphics: Locate image information
			text: Locate text information
 		-->
        <Type>graphics</Type>
        <!-- When Type=text, this is the text information to search for -->
        <Content></Content>
    </Payload>
</Command>

<!-- Response -->
<CommandResponse>
  <CommandType>AnalysisDrawCall</CommandType>
  <MsgGuid>5489449c-c463-4ac3-a7ed-e166ac8de4c8</MsgGuid>
  <Success>True</Success>
  <Payload>[DRAW CALL] [IL:-1] GLOBAL.DMD&lt;Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Graphics.SpriteBatch::Draw&gt;
[DRAW CALL] [IL:363] Hacknet.Effects.HexGridBackground.Draw
[DRAW CALL] [IL:-1] GLOBAL.DMD&lt;Hacknet.MainMenu::Draw&gt;
[DRAW CALL] [IL:73] Hacknet.ScreenManager.Draw
[DRAW CALL] [IL:112] Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Game.Draw
[DRAW CALL] [IL:-1] GLOBAL.DMD&lt;Hacknet.Game1::Draw&gt;
[DRAW CALL] [IL:524] Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Game.Tick
[DRAW CALL] [IL:1474] Microsoft.Xna.Framework.SDL2_FNAPlatform.RunLoop
[DRAW CALL] [IL:55] Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Game.Run
[DRAW CALL] [IL:-1] GLOBAL.DMD&lt;Hacknet.Program::Main&gt;
</Payload>
```



## VSCode Plugin Support

The [HacknetExtensionHelper](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=fengxu30338.hacknetextensionhelper) plugin already includes all the features of this pf plugin. You can install this plugin in VSCode to more easily call the above features.

If you have other requirements, you can add a new message handler and merge your code into this repository. If you need the VSCode plugin to provide calls, you can leave a message in this repository's issue, and I will handle it when I have time.





## About

If you use this mod, please indicate the source in the mod description.
